native_policy_fidelity: An original forbidden list is an evaluation annotation, not permission metadata to be injected into the retrieval engine. Derive actual access and lifecycle eligibility only from source metadata and native policy. If any native current_answer freshness rule does not make stale documents inadmissible, mark that particular policy assertion unsupported rather than fabricating a restriction.
